brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Floods and landslides have killed 56 people in India and 14 in Nepal. [1]
India's Assetgro FinTech has filed for an IPO via a confidential route. [2]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR INDIA
The floods and landslides in India, combined with a Country Instability Index score of 50, indicate a normal but vulnerable stability level. [1][E1]
India's net energy import dependency of 36% underscores its vulnerability to global energy price shocks, even as it voices concerns at the UN about paying for distant conflicts. [3][E4]

KEY RISKS
India's link to 176 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations exposes it to secondary sanctions risks. [E3]
The most severe government travel advisory for India is Exercise Increased Caution, reflecting a risk to travelers and business operations. [E2]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market on the Reserve Bank of India making no change to the policy repo rate at the October meeting is priced at 17% as of Sep 28, 2026, closing Oct 7, 2026. [E5]
A Polymarket market on India striking Pakistan by December 31, 2026 is priced at 13% as of Sep 28, 2026, closing Jan 1, 2027. [E6]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of Assetgro FinTech's confidential IPO filing remains unresolved. [2]
It is unclear whether the Reserve Bank of India will change the policy repo rate at the October meeting. [E5]
